changelog:
Initial release of the write-contracts skill for secure Move V2 smart contract generation.

- Generates Aptos Move V2 smart contracts using Object model and Digital Asset (NFT) standards
- Integrates key security patterns and storage type selection framework
- Provides module structure templates, example patterns, and testing access patterns
- Triggers on common prompts like “write contract”, “create NFT collection”, and more
- Guides optimal storage design by asking usage questions and recommending best-fit data structures
